retrospective_synthesis.purpose: Reconcile the frozen #474 jump-by-curve short-regime Blocks 2-4 result without rescue tuning and preserve the boundary to protected 2023+ confirmation.
retrospective_synthesis.historical_fact_rule: Preserve every historical result for the exact role and configuration tested; a negative may be revisited only under a scientifically distinct role that the prior evidence did not rule out.
retrospective_synthesis.state_rule: At each historical decision timestamp, future outcomes remain unavailable; any adaptive selection, weighting, fitting, sizing, lifecycle or execution choice must be derived from prior or inner-validation evidence only.

refresh_triggers: A scientifically distinct post-#474 successor is authorized with explicit evidence reclassification and a fresh pre-outcome freeze.
A source/PIT gate releases or permanently rejects a material held information family before #414 freeze.

known: #459 promoted a joint development policy with +0.324275 percentage points/month mean outer improvement and positive deltas in both development outers.
#429 did not promote a tested static lifecycle variant, while its ablations confirmed material contribution from strength gating, loss cooldown and the long specialist veto.
#430 promoted state-dependent sizing `regime_favored1_50_other0_75` with +0.1276375 percentage points/month mean outer improvement and no promoted incremental Stage-2 risk-control rule.

#431 selected `decay20` with +0.4456875 percentage points/month versus fixed adaptation; same-session stress remained positive, but every tested one-session-delay cross-execution configuration failed.

#474 froze Candidate A (high-jump contango short) and Candidate B (A plus low-jump backwardation) before Blocks 2-4. At 1.5 contracts both returned +4.935% base but -5.25% moderate and -7.68% severe; always-short returned +27.0075% severe.
repeatedly_failed: Treating one static lifecycle parameterization as a universal improvement across development periods.
Adding the tested Stage-2 stop, drawdown, take-profit, time-stop or extra-cooldown controls on top of the #430 sizing parent.
Preserving the #431 adaptation advantage after one full session of execution delay.
The exact #474 jump-by-curve short-vs-flat selector failed stress positivity and return/drawdown improvement over always-short on frozen Blocks 2-4; Candidate B's extra leg never activated.
mechanisms_still_alive: State- and regime-dependent technical, fundamental, positioning, volatility and market-structure information.
Adaptive memory, training-window and expert-weight selection.
State-dependent sizing and dynamic existing-position management.
Mechanism-aligned horizons and execution clocks where point-in-time timing is provable.
Unconditional short exposure across Blocks 2-4 is a research lead only; its structural persistence, causal state dependence, and execution robustness remain unproven.
missing_not_negative: Event-time source timing remains held because authoritative publication-time semantics are not yet proven.
Underpowered and role-unidentifiable historical clues remain unresolved outside the exact roles already tested.
Source-gated families remain unavailable until their registered PIT/source gates pass.
integrated_system_needs: A deterministic point-in-time time-instance state dataset keyed by legitimate decision timestamp.
A timestamped expert-output archive for TimesFM, Kronos and other eligible specialists.
Trailing expert-effectiveness features over multiple memory lengths and comparable prior states.
A causal walk-forward controller for expert weighting, horizon, abstention, sizing and position actions.
A development-only oracle-gap diagnostic that separates underlying opportunity from causal selection ability.
A successor must distinguish broad short market exposure from genuine state-selection value and must be frozen before evaluation rather than tuned to #474 outcomes.
current_helicopter_view.next_branch_reason: #474 rejected/materially weakened the frozen A/B jump-by-curve selector. Any continuation should be a distinct pre-frozen investigation of why broad short exposure dominated and whether a causal selector can improve its risk/execution profile without reusing Blocks 2-4 as fresh confirmation.
